verdict.rationale: Persona's Cases feature provides a configurable UI for operations teams with built-in analytics, SLAs, and automations, and Workflows explicitly reduce manual review time by automating decisions and tagging high-risk inquiries — together these support a manual-review-queue orchestration story. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly detail that the queue surfaces full evidence (document images, extracted fields, check results) or confirm that reviewer decisions are written back into the underlying record/account. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence display within Cases, and explicit confirmation of reviewer decision write-back to the account/inquiry record.
